name: Thunderhorns Bericht
summary: Mull sends you to carry Thunderhorn’s report to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. The elders need to hear what your help has accomplished.

sections.title: The Report
sections.body: You bring Thunderhorn’s report to Hamuul on the Elder Rise in eastern Thunder Bluff. The report concerns Mulgore’s springs, which sustain the tauren and the animals they rely on for food, clothing, and companionship.

faq.answer: Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff needs Thunderhorn’s report.
Hamuul is on the Elder Rise in eastern Thunder Bluff.
Mulgore’s springs support the tauren and the animals they rely on for food, clothing, and companionship.

faq.q: What does Hamuul say about the springs?
faq.answer: Hamuul says the springs sustain both the tauren and the animals they depend on.
